extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and the Web Store

extShortName.description: Short name for narrow UI surfaces (max ~12 chars)

extDescription.message: Highlight and underline local .md and .html files — your marks survive closing the tab.

onbLede.message: To work on local .md and .html files it needs one Chrome permission that you must enable by hand. For security reasons an extension cannot grant this itself.

onbStatusGrantedDetail.message: The extension can work on local .md and .html files. You can close this tab.

onbStatusDeniedDetail.message: Complete the two steps below; this page detects the moment it is enabled.

onbStep1.message: Use the button below to open this extension's details page.

onbHintChromeUrl.message: $URL$ — chrome:// addresses cannot be opened as links, so we use a button.

onbStep2.message: On that page, scroll down and turn on <mark class="setting">Allow access to file URLs</mark>.

onbStep2Hint.message: Chrome reloads the extension when you flip it; this tab may refresh, which is normal. After it refreshes you will see the green confirmation here.

onbStep3.message: Come back to this tab. Verification happens automatically.

onbProofLede.message: Once the permission is on, open any local file in Chrome (.md or .html). It shows up below the moment the extension can reach that page — a measurement, not a claim.

onbProofWaiting.message: Has not run on a local file yet.

onbFoot.message: If you turn the permission off later, the toolbar icon turns grey with a $BADGE$ badge; click it to come back here.

popupCtxLocalActive.message: This tab is a local file — the extension is active here.

popupCtxLocalBlocked.message: This tab is a local file, but permission is off so it cannot be reached.

popupCtxUnsupported.message: Highlighting is not available on this page.

onbPinOnDetail.message: The icon sits next to the address bar, so you can see status at a glance.

onbPinOffDetail.message: The icon is hidden in the puzzle menu — you cannot see the status colour or open the popup quickly.

onbPinHow.message: Click the puzzle piece icon in the toolbar, find Doc Highlighter in the list, then click the pin icon next to it. The details page has a Pin to toolbar switch that does the same thing.

onbPinNote.message: Why is there no button here? Chrome does not let an extension pin itself — there is no API for it, and no manifest key. The toolbar belongs to you. This page can only read the state and detect the moment you pin it.

tbReload.message: Extension was reloaded — refresh this page (F5). Your highlights are safe.

popupAllOff.message: Not enabled on websites — only on sites you allow.

tbClearAll.message: Erase all highlights on this page

pnlNoHeadings.message: No headings found in this document.

pnlNoMarks.message: Nothing highlighted on this page yet.

pnlOrphan.message: This text is not on the page right now.

pnlNoNotes.message: No notes on this page yet.

qmContrastLow.message: Below WCAG AAA — text on this colour may be hard to read

qmTranslateDesc.message: Translate a highlighted passage into your target language, on the device.

qmColoursHint.message: Tap a stroke to change it. The number is the contrast against the text — under 7:1 it stops meeting WCAG AAA.

qmRuleNoRatio.message: A rule under the text, not a wash behind it — the contrast rule does not apply

qmAddonsHint.message: Optional extras. Nothing is on unless you turn it on.

trUnavailable.message: Translation is not available in this browser.

trNeedsChrome.message: Needs Chrome 138 or newer on desktop. Chrome runs the model itself; it is not available here.

trModelNote.message: Runs on your device. The first use of a language pair downloads a model — that download is Chrome's, and no page text is sent anywhere.

qmPulse.message: Pulse a note mark when it first appears

qmPulseWhy.message: One short pulse, under the WCAG flash threshold, to make a small mark findable. Turn it off if you would rather nothing moved. Reduced-motion settings are honoured either way.

qmRecentHint.message: What you marked, newest first. Click a place to open it again.
